documents.title: Compliances-Certificate under Reg. 74 (5) of SEBI (DP) Regulations, 2018

analysis.summary: Pasupati Acrylon reported an 8.03% increase in revenue from operations to Rs. 62,143.18 Lakh and a 168.24% growth in profit after tax to Rs. 3,538.12 Lakh for FY 2024-25. The company successfully commissioned its 150 KL per day grain-based Ethanol Plant in March 2025, with a total spend of around Rs. 188 Crore.

guidance.claim: The company is exploring possibilities of increasing exports and is hopeful of achieving better exports in the coming years.
guidance.quote: The Company has exported to Dubai, Peru, Thailand, Morrocco, Tunisia, Nepal, Ukraine, Turkey, Algeria, Kenya, Brazil, Poland, Lebanon etc. and is exploring possibilities of increasing exports and it is hopeful to achieve better exports in the coming years.

guidance.claim: The company anticipates sustained demand growth across its segments.
guidance.quote: Your Company anticipates sustained demand growth across segments.

guidance.claim: The company expects its initiatives to improve its financial performance, although forecasting productivity and profitability in quantifiable terms is difficult.
guidance.quote: However, it is difficult to forecast the productivity and profitability in quantifiable terms but the Company expects that the above initiatives are expected to improve the financial performance of the Company.

guidance.claim: The company expects to commence commercial production of its grain-based Ethanol Project by September, 2024.
guidance.quote: Further, the Company has already initiated steps to establish grain based Ethanol Project with a production capacity of 150 KLPD and it is expected to commence commercial production of Ethanol by September, 2024.

guidance.claim: The company expects sales and production to improve further in the coming years, though it notes the need to monitor factors like inflation and high energy prices.
guidance.quote: The sale and production has seen good improvement from previous year and it is expected to improve more in the coming years but it is necessary to carefully watch other factors such as inflation, high energy prices etc.

guidance.claim: The company is hopeful of achieving better exports in the current year.
guidance.quote: The Company has exported to Dubai, Egypt, Peru, Ukraine, Turkey, Algeria, Kenya, Nigeria, Brazil, Lebanon etc. and is exploring possibilities of increasing exports and it is hopeful to achieve better exports this year.

demand_outlook.claim: The overall acrylic fibre market is projected to grow at a 4.2% CAGR until 2035 due to the rapid growth of the apparel and textile industry.
demand_outlook.quote: With the rapid growth of the apparel & textile industry and increasing usage of acrylic fibres for making apparel, the overall acrylic fibre market is projected to rise at 4.2% CAGR till 2035.

demand_outlook.claim: Macroeconomic development of end-use sectors is expected to drive up the demand for acrylic fibers in the coming years.
demand_outlook.quote: The demand for acrylic fibers is anticipated to rise in the coming years, particularly due to the macroeconomic development of end-use sectors which is supported by regional GDP and population growth.

demand_outlook.claim: The CPP films industry is projected to expand at a robust rate due to rising packaging requirements across sectors and rapid growth in retail and e-commerce.
demand_outlook.quote: With the rising requirement for packaging across sectors, with traditional businesses preferring to package products, and the retail and e-commerce growing rapidly, the CPP films industry is projected to expand at a robust rate.

demand_outlook.claim: The market for CPP films is primarily driven by expanding demand from the food and beverage sector and the rising use of bags and pouches.
demand_outlook.quote: The market for CPP Films is primarily driven by the rapidly expanding demand from the food and beverage sector and the rising use of bags and pouches in end-use industries.

demand_outlook.claim: The demand for ethanol is expected to reach 1016 Crore litres according to a report by the Expert Committee of Niti Aayog.
demand_outlook.quote: As per report of Expert Committee of Nity Aayog on Roadmap for Ethanol Blending, the demand for ethanol is expected to be 1016 Crore litres.

demand_outlook.claim: The company's revenue and net profit declined due to lower demand for acrylic fibre and negative returns on the CPP segment caused by falling selling prices.
demand_outlook.quote: Revenue and Net profit during the year declined due to lower demand of acrylic fibre and negative return on CPP Segment caused by persistent fall in selling prices on account of excessive production capacity added in the market.

demand_outlook.claim: Sale and production declined due to lower demand, but improved in the last quarter of FY 2023-24 due to better market sentiments and is expected to improve in the coming years.
demand_outlook.quote: During the year, the sale and production was declined due to lower demand but in the last quarter of FY 2023-24, it was improved due to better sentiments in the market and it is expected to improve in the coming years.

demand_outlook.claim: Demand for Acrylic Fibre has increased, leading to higher production and sales compared to the previous year.
demand_outlook.quote: Demand of Acrylic Fibre has risen and the Company’s production and sales of Acrylic Fibre was 36,425 MT and 35,260 MT respectively as compared to production of 29,652 MT and sales of 30,918 MT during the previous year.

demand_outlook.claim: Acrylic Fibre consumption improved during the year as concerns related to COVID-19 subsided.
demand_outlook.quote: During the year under review, Acrylic Fibre consumption has been improved as COVID-19 related concerns were subsided.

demand_outlook.claim: Net profit declined due to a negative return on the CPP segment, which was caused by a persistent drop in selling prices from excess market capacity.
demand_outlook.quote: Net profit during the year declined due to negative return on CPP Segment caused by persistent fall in selling prices on account of excessive production capacity added in the market.

capex_expansion.claim: The company successfully commissioned its 150 KL per day grain-based Ethanol Plant and started commercial production in March 2025.
capex_expansion.quote: The Company has successfully commissioned its 150 KL per day grain-based Ethanol Plant and commenced commercial production in March, 2025.

capex_expansion.claim: The total project cost for the ethanol plant was initially assessed at Rs. 167 Crore but experienced overruns due to civil work.
capex_expansion.quote: The total project cost was assessed Rs. 167 Crore (excluding working capital margin) but the project was overrun due to Civil work.

capex_expansion.claim: The company has spent around Rs. 188 Crore so far on the project, funded by Rs. 104 Crore of term loan and the balance from internal accruals.
capex_expansion.quote: Company has spent around Rs. 188 Crore so far which includes Rs. 104 Crore of Term Loan and Balance amount out of internal accruals.

capex_expansion.claim: A solar power system of 750 KW has been installed by the company.
capex_expansion.quote: Solar Power System of 750 KW has been installed.

capex_expansion.claim: The company approved setting up an Ethanol Project with a production capacity of 150 KLPD.
capex_expansion.quote: Board of Directors, at its meeting held on 18th May, 2022, had accorded its approval to the Company to set-up Ethanol Project with a production capacity of 150 KLPD to align with GOI’s Ethanol Blending Programme (E20), subject to clearance and approvals from the concerned statutory authorities.

capex_expansion.claim: The total project cost for the Ethanol Project is Rs. 167.58 crores.
capex_expansion.quote: The total Project cost is Rs. 167.58 crores.

capex_expansion.claim: The company has already spent around Rs. 92.17 Crore on the project, which includes Rs. 44.08 Crores of Term Loan and the balance from internal accruals.
capex_expansion.quote: However, the Company has already spent around Rs. 92.17 Crore so far which includes Rs. 44.08 Crores of Term Loan and balance amount out of internal accruals.

capex_expansion.claim: Civil work is ongoing at the site, and a major order for Plant & Machinery has been placed.
capex_expansion.quote: Civil work is going on at the site and major order for Plant & Machinery has been placed.

capex_expansion.claim: The company has altered its Objects Clause to enable diversification into a 150 KLPD Grain Based Ethanol Plant.
capex_expansion.quote: The Company has, vide Special Resolution passed by the Shareholders at their Annual General Meeting held on 29th September, 2022, altered the Objects Clause of Memorandum of Association of the Company to enable the Company to diversify its business in Ethanol Product and accordingly, the Company has initiated the steps to set-up 150 KLPD Grain Based Ethanol Plant.

capex_expansion.claim: The company has initiated steps to set up the Ethanol Plant adjacent to its existing manufacturing unit in Thakurdwara.
capex_expansion.quote: The Company has initiated steps to set up Ethanol Plant adjoining to its existing manufacturing unit – Thakurdwara, Dist. Moradabad (Uttar Pradesh).

capex_expansion.claim: The company has received environmental clearance for the project and is finalizing vendors and releasing advances from internal accruals.
capex_expansion.quote: The Company has obtained Environment Clearance for the proposed project and company is under process to finalize various vendors/ suppliers / consultants for the projects and releasing advances to them as per contract out of its Internal Accruals.

margins_costs.claim: Volatility in the prices of raw materials, energy, coal, and other key inputs impacts global acrylic fibre consumption.
margins_costs.quote: Global Acrylic Fibre consumption is impacted due to volatility in prices of raw material, energy, coal and other key inputs.

margins_costs.claim: The raw materials required to produce the company's products are derived from crude.
margins_costs.quote: The raw material to produce the Company’s products is crude derived.

margins_costs.claim: Crude price fluctuations affect raw material prices, and crude prices remained volatile during the year due to geopolitical conflicts.
margins_costs.quote: The fluctuation in crude affects the raw material prices to some extent and during the year under the review, the crude prices remained volatile due to conflict in Israel-Hamas War & Russia-Ukraine War.

margins_costs.claim: Foreign exchange fluctuations between the USD and INR affect the company's margins due to its dependence on imports.
margins_costs.quote: Additionally, since the Company is dependent upon imports, the fluctuation in foreign exchange i.e. USD vs. INR has also a bearing on the margin of the Company.

margins_costs.claim: The loss in the CPP segment declined during the year under review due to better realization and lower overheads.
margins_costs.quote: During the year under review, loss of CPP has been declined due to better realization and reduction in overheads.

margins_costs.claim: Cost optimization initiatives through alternate sourcing, standardization, and process improvements have led to significant savings.
margins_costs.quote: Various cost optimisation driven by way of alternate sourcing, standardization, process improvements and operational efficiency improvements has led significant savings.

margins_costs.claim: Operating Profit Margin, Net Profit Margin, and Return on Net Worth declined because the cost of production was relatively high compared to the previous year.
margins_costs.quote: Operating Profit Margin, Net Profit Margin and Return on Net Worth are declined as cost of production was relatively high as compared to previous year.

margins_costs.claim: The company faced challenges including volatile crude prices, rising raw material costs, dumping of acrylic fibre, and foreign exchange fluctuations.
margins_costs.quote: Despite various challenges such as volatility in crude prices and abnormal rise in raw material prices, dumping of acrylic fibre by Turkey, China, Thailand and Belarus, foreign exchange fluctuations, the Company is focused on improvement in its growth and in a position to achieve a better turnover as compared to previous year.

margins_costs.claim: Fluctuations in crude oil prices affect raw material costs as the raw materials are crude-derived.
margins_costs.quote: The fluctuation in crude affects the raw material prices to some extent and during the year under the review, the crude prices remained volatile and witnessed a continued rise due to Russia-Ukraine War.

margins_costs.claim: The CPP segment incurred a loss due to a persistent fall in selling prices caused by excessive production capacity in the market.
margins_costs.quote: Loss of CPP segment is incurred during the year caused by persistent fall in selling prices on account of excessive production capacity added in the market.

orders_capacity.claim: The company has an installed production capacity of 42,000 MT PA for acrylic products.
orders_capacity.quote: The production capacity to produce Acrylic products of the Company is 42,000 MT PA.

orders_capacity.claim: During the year under review, the company produced 35,198 MT and sold 33,850 MT of acrylic products.
orders_capacity.quote: During the year under review, the Company has recorded production of 35,198 MT and Sale of 33,850 MT, as against production of 31,534 MT and Sale of 31,685 MT respectively during the previous year.

orders_capacity.claim: The company's production capacity for CPP film is 10,000 MT PA.
orders_capacity.quote: The Company’s production capacity to produce CPP film is 10000 MT PA.

orders_capacity.claim: The production and sale of CPP film stood at 6,343 MT and 6,409 MT respectively during the year under review.
orders_capacity.quote: During the year under review, the production and sale of CPP film was 6,343 MT and 6,409 MT respectively as against production of 6,463 MT and sale of 6,476 MT respectively during the previous year.

orders_capacity.claim: The company produced 790 KL and sold 440 KL of ethanol during the year under review.
orders_capacity.quote: During the year under review, the production and sale of Ethanol was 790 KL and 440 KL respectively.

orders_capacity.claim: During the year under review, the company recorded Acrylic production of 31,534 MT and sales of 31,685 MT.
orders_capacity.quote: During the year under review, the Company has recorded production of 31,534 MT and Sale of 31,685 MT, as against production of 36,425 MT and Sale of 35,260 MT respectively during the previous year.

orders_capacity.claim: During the year under review, the production and sale of CPP film was 6,463 MT and 6,476 MT respectively.
orders_capacity.quote: During the year under review, the production and sale of CPP film was 6,463 MT and 6,476 MT respectively as against production of 7,663 MT and sale of 7,640 MT respectively during the previous year.

orders_capacity.claim: The company's installed production capacity for Acrylic products is 45,000 MT per annum.
orders_capacity.quote: The production capacity to produce Acrylic products of the Company is 45,000 MT PA.

orders_capacity.claim: During the year, the company produced 36,425 MT and sold 35,260 MT of Acrylic products.
orders_capacity.quote: During the year under review, the Company has recorded production of 36,425 MT and Sale of 35,260 MT, as against production of 29,652 MT and Sale of 30,918 MT respectively during the previous year.

orders_capacity.claim: Production and sales of CPP film increased to 7,663 MT and 7,640 MT respectively during the year.
orders_capacity.quote: During the year under review, the production and sale of CPP film increased to 7,663 MT and 7,640 MT respectively as against production of 6,348 MT and sale of 6,210 MT respectively during the previous year.

capital_allocation.claim: The Board of Directors decided not to recommend any dividend for the financial year 2024-25.
capital_allocation.quote: During the year under review the Board of Directors decided not to recommend any dividend for the financial year 2024-25.

capital_allocation.claim: The Board of Directors decided not to transfer any amount to the General Reserve for the year ended March 31, 2025.
capital_allocation.quote: The Board of Directors of your company, has decided not to transfer any amount to the General Reserve for the year ended 31st March, 2025.

capital_allocation.claim: The debt-equity ratio and interest coverage ratio varied due to an increase in the term loan availed for the grain-based ethanol plant and its interest.
capital_allocation.quote: Debt-Equity Ratio and Interest Coverage Ratio were varied due to increase in Term Loan availed for Grain based Ethanol Plant and interest thereon.

capital_allocation.claim: The Board of Directors decided not to recommend any dividend for the financial year 2023-24 as internal accruals are being utilized to set up the Ethanol Plant.
capital_allocation.quote: As the Company’s internal accruals is being utilized to set-up Ethanol Plant, the Board of Directors decided not to recommend any dividend for the financial year 2023-24.

capital_allocation.claim: The remaining project cost of Rs. 59.58 crores for the Ethanol Project will be met out of the company's internal accruals.
capital_allocation.quote: Indian Bank had sanctioned Term Loan of Rs. 108 Crores and as per stipulations of sanction letter, the remaining project cost of Rs. 59.58 would be met out of the Company’s internal accruals.

capital_allocation.claim: The Board of Directors decided not to transfer any amount to the Reserves for the year under review.
capital_allocation.quote: The Board of Directors of your company, has decided not to transfer any amount to the Reserves for the year under review.

capital_allocation.claim: The Board decided not to recommend any dividend for the year, choosing instead to plough back earnings to strengthen financials.
capital_allocation.quote: The Board of Directors decided to plough back the earnings to strengthen the financials of the Company and not to recommend dividend for the year under review.

capital_allocation.claim: The remaining project cost of Rs. 59.58 crores will be funded through internal accruals.
capital_allocation.quote: The remaining project cost of Rs. 59.58 will be met out of the Company’s internal accruals.

risks_headwinds.claim: Geopolitical tensions, supply chain disruptions, policy changes, and intense competition are key risks exposing the company to challenges.
risks_headwinds.quote: Other geo-political tensions including supply chain disruption, subdued global economic conditions, changes in government policies and trade sanctions and restrictions, intense competition from local and global players, regulatory changes and cyber security threats are key risks which expose the Company to potential challenges and uncertainties.

risks_headwinds.claim: Persistent volatility in input costs and foreign exchange risks remain key concerns for the company.
risks_headwinds.quote: Furthermore, persistent volatility in input costs and foreign exchange risks remains on the radar.

risks_headwinds.claim: Climatic vagaries and changes in government policies are among the most pressing challenges in the industry.
risks_headwinds.quote: One of the most pressing challenges that remain is climatic vagaries in this industry, and at times changes in government policies.

risks_headwinds.claim: The continued absence of increases in Minimum Selling Price adjustments poses direct threats to forward planning and capacity utilization.
risks_headwinds.quote: Additionally, the continued absence of non-increase in Minimum Selling Price adjustments pose direct threats to forward planning, capacity utilisation, and return on invested capital

risks_headwinds.claim: The company has no control over the prices of ethanol products, which are determined by Oil Marketing Companies.
risks_headwinds.quote: The prices of ethanol products are determined by Oil Marketing Companies (“OMC”) and the Company has no control on the prices.

risks_headwinds.claim: Since raw material is crude derived, price movements in either direction affect raw material prices.
risks_headwinds.quote: Since raw material is crude derived as such movement either side shall affect the raw material price.

risks_headwinds.claim: The company faces challenges such as volatility in crude and raw material prices, dumping of acrylic fibre by China, Thailand, and Belarus, and foreign exchange fluctuations.
risks_headwinds.quote: Despite various challenges such as volatility in crude prices and raw material prices, dumping of acrylic fibre by China, Thailand and Belarus, foreign exchange fluctuations, the Company is focused on improvement in its revenue and net profit.

risks_headwinds.claim: Key risks exposing the company to challenges include geopolitical tensions, supply chain disruptions, subdued global economic conditions, policy changes, trade sanctions, intense competition, regulatory changes, and cyber security threats.
risks_headwinds.quote: Geo-political tensions including supply chain disruption, subdued global economic conditions, changes in government policies and trade sanctions and restrictions, intense competition from local and global players, regulatory changes and cyber security threats are key risks which expose the Company to potential challenges and uncertainties.

risks_headwinds.claim: The risk from the COVID-19 pandemic remains a key business risk despite subsided concerns.
risks_headwinds.quote: Though COVID-19 related concerns have been subsided in the world, but the risk from the COVID-19 pandemic continues to be one of the key business risks.

risks_headwinds.claim: Sudden movements in the USD and rising crude oil prices due to the Russia-Ukraine war affect the company's margins.
risks_headwinds.quote: Further, since the Company is dependent upon imported raw materials, sudden movement in USD and increase in crude oil prices due to Russia-Ukraine war affects the margin.

risks_headwinds.claim: The global economy is likely to face headwinds from high energy costs, logistics issues, and international trade costs.
risks_headwinds.quote: Global economy is likely to be hit by continuing high energy cost, logistics issues and costs in international trade.

risks_headwinds.claim: Monetary policy tightening by central banks to curb inflation could impact consumption in the Acrylic Fiber and CPP Films industries.
risks_headwinds.quote: Tightening of monetary policies by Central banks to curb inflation may have necessary impact which will impact consumption in general including Acrylic Fiber & CPP Films Industry.

risks_headwinds.claim: The CPP Film market is highly competitive due to the presence of multiple vendors.
risks_headwinds.quote: The CPP Film Market is highly competitive owing to the presence of multiple vendors in the market.

risks_headwinds.claim: Stringent packaging regulations, changing consumer preferences, and environmental pressures may restrain growth.
risks_headwinds.quote: On the other hand, stringent regulations concerning packaging, changing consumer preferences and environmental pressures may restrain the growth to some extent.

management_commitments.claim: The company is focusing on increasing exports to mitigate the effect of raw material price fluctuations.
management_commitments.quote: The Company is giving thrust on increasing the exports so that effect can be mitigated.

management_commitments.claim: The company consistently invests in equipment, processes, and systems to ensure compliance with manufacturing and audit norms.
management_commitments.quote: The Company consistently invests in equipment, processes, and systems to ensure full compliance with manufacturing and audit norms.

management_commitments.claim: The company expects to commence commercial production of its grain-based Ethanol Project by September, 2024.
management_commitments.quote: Further, the Company has already initiated steps to establish grain based Ethanol Project with a production capacity of 150 KLPD and it is expected to commence commercial production of Ethanol by September, 2024.

management_commitments.claim: The company is hopeful of achieving better exports in the current year.
management_commitments.quote: The Company has exported to Dubai, Egypt, Peru, Ukraine, Turkey, Algeria, Kenya, Nigeria, Brazil, Lebanon etc. and is exploring possibilities of increasing exports and it is hopeful to achieve better exports this year.

management_commitments.claim: The company expects sales and production to improve further in the coming years.
management_commitments.quote: The sale and production has seen good improvement from previous year and it is expected to improve more in the coming years but it is necessary to carefully watch other factors such as inflation, high energy prices etc.

_meta.note: Facts are verbatim-grounded against the company's own documents; claims whose quote was not found were dropped.
